note: Python / uv version holds, read by `yolo update uv status|plan|apply`. A hold refuses a release above `maxMajor` or `maxVersion` and names the blocker; the pinned or capped state must stay in the pyproject it lives in (torch ==2.8.0, magika ~=0.6.1, sentence-transformers <6, markitdown). Entries with scope `transitive` explain packages the resolver keeps back because a parent caps them; they carry no manifest edit. `name` may end in `*`. Re-check on every `uv lock --upgrade`: remove the entry as soon as the blocker moves (yolo update uv status lists a cap without an entry as NO REASON). Advisory-only holds live in config/deps/advisory-holds.json.

holds.name: torch
holds.reason: aphrody-train pins ==2.8.0: the 2.14.0 Windows wheel failed to import torch.amp in the CPU smoke test; 2.14.1 (2026-10) only fixes MPS and CUDA 13.2 items. Re-run the Windows CPU smoke with 2.14.x before lifting; the cu129 index must also carry the wheel.

holds.name: transformers
holds.reason: aphrody-train stays below 4.58: sentence-transformers[onnx] 5.x needs optimum-onnx 0.1.0, which caps transformers; 5.x needs sentence-transformers 6 (the `mine` extra), which has no ONNX export and cannot share an environment with `full`.

holds.name: sentence-transformers
holds.reason: `full` extra of aphrody-train keeps sentence-transformers[onnx] on 5.x (optimum-onnx caps transformers below 4.58); the `mine` extra already resolves 6.1.0 in its own conflict fork.

holds.name: magika
holds.reason: markitdown hard-pins magika~=0.6.1 as a core dependency, so magika 1.x and markitdown cannot share an environment; classify.py supports both result shapes, a markitdown bump makes the upgrade a no-op.

holds.name: maturin
holds.reason: exact build-backend pin of the aphrody SDK (docs/sdk/native-build.md, tests/test_build_backend_reproducibility.py). 1.15.0 changes the sdist tar headers (UID and GID in pax) and hardens the PEP 517 build-wheel path, so the reproducible-sdist and RECORD-integrity checks and the cargo-built wheels need a full requalification (uv build, tools/sdk/verify-wheel.py on all six CI jobs), which needs Cargo and stays with the lead's serialized build.

holds.name: torchvision
holds.reason: follows the torch 2.8.0 hold (torchvision 0.23 is the 2.8 release).

holds.name: triton
holds.reason: bound by the torch 2.8.0 hold (torch pins its triton release).

holds.name: nvidia-*
holds.reason: CUDA runtime wheels are pinned by the torch wheel that pulls them (2.8.0+cu129 in aphrody-train); they move with torch.

holds.name: cuda-*
holds.reason: CUDA runtime wheels are pinned by torch.

holds.name: tokenizers
holds.reason: transformers 4.57.6 requires tokenizers <=0.23.0 (transformers hold); the `mine` fork already uses 0.23.2 with transformers 5.

holds.name: optimum
holds.reason: optimum-onnx 0.1.0 requires optimum >=2.1,<2.2 (transformers hold).

holds.name: huggingface-hub
holds.reason: docling-slim requires huggingface-hub <2 and transformers 4.57.6 requires <1.0; 2.x needs both to move.

holds.name: typer
holds.reason: docling-slim[standard] requires typer <0.27; moves with the next docling release.

holds.name: semchunk
holds.reason: docling-core[chunking] requires semchunk <4; moves with docling-core.

holds.name: mammoth
holds.reason: markitdown[docx] requires mammoth >=1.11,<1.12.dev0; moves with markitdown.

holds.name: websockets
holds.reason: google-genai requires websockets <17; moves with google-genai.

holds.name: fsspec
holds.reason: datasets 5.0.1 requires fsspec[http] <=2026.6.0; moves with the next datasets release.

holds.name: multidict
holds.reason: aiohttp (datasets, fsspec[http]) requires multidict <7.

holds.name: antlr4-python3-runtime
holds.reason: omegaconf 2.3.1 requires antlr4-python3-runtime==4.9.*.

holds.name: mpmath
holds.reason: sympy 1.14 requires mpmath <1.4.

holds.name: pydantic-core
holds.reason: pydantic 2.13.5 pins pydantic-core==2.46.5; the newer core ships with the 2.14 beta only.

holds.name: onnxruntime
holds.reason: magika 0.6.x requires onnxruntime <=1.20.1 on Windows (magika hold); onnxruntime 1.30 also ships no macOS x86_64 wheel, so the SDK lock forks per platform.
